analysis.title: Rockwell Automation Inc. (ROK): First Take: F4Q beat, FY27 guide broadly inline
key_insights: ROK F4Q26 segment EBIT beat GS and FactSet consensus by +3% and +6%, driven mainly by better margins in Intelligent Devices and Lifecycle Services.
ROK started a customer tariff refund program to return about $85mn of IEEPA refunds received this quarter. It cut F4Q26 organic sales growth by 4 percentage points, from +7% to +3%.

Discrete market growth for FY26 is now up high teens, versus the prior outlook of up mid teens. Automotive is up low double digits (prior: up high single digits) and Semiconductor is up 25% (prior: up 20%).
FY27 guidance is organic sales growth of +6% to +9%, which implies about $9.0bn of sales at the mid-point. Adjusted EPS guidance is $14.50 to $15.50.

The FY27 EPS bridge has core growth and share buyback benefits (total $1.80 EPS tailwind) offsetting net IEEPA tariff refund items, interest expense, corporate items and pension (total $0.22 headwind).

GS expects the shares to underperform today given the modest beat and in-line FY27 guide, though the move also depends on the cadence and confidence of the FY27 guide. GS says the bar this quarter has been high.
On the call GS will look for color on F1Q27 and support for ROK's end market outlook of Discrete up high single digits and Hybrid/Process up mid single digits.
GS rates ROK Neutral with a 12-month price target of $485, based on 21.0x Q5-Q8E EBITDA. The stock closed at $443.88 on 4 Nov 2026, which implies 9.3% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and a $485 target (21.0x Q5-Q8E EBITDA) after a modest F4Q beat and an in-line FY27 guide. GS expects the shares to underperform today.

earnings_insights: ROK F4Q26 adjusted EPS reported $3.88 vs GS consensus est $3.74 and FactSet consensus est $3.69 (reported 5 Nov 2026).
F4Q26 segment EBIT beat GS estimates by 3% and FactSet consensus by 6%. Total segment operating income was $588mn vs GS est $557mn and consensus $570mn, a 24.3% margin vs GS est 23.5%.
F4Q26 total revenue was $2,417mn (+4.4% y/y) vs GS est $2,372mn and consensus $2,422mn. Organic growth was +3%, after a roughly 4 point reduction from the ~$85mn IEEPA tariff refund program.

Intelligent Devices revenue was $1,144mn (+5.3% y/y) vs GS est $1,108mn, with margin of 21.6% vs GS est 20.6%. Software & Control revenue was $754mn (+14.8% y/y) vs GS est $763mn, with margin of 34.0% vs GS est 33.1%. Lifecycle Services revenue was $519mn (-9.4% y/y) vs GS est $501mn, with margin of 16.4% vs GS est 15.3%.
Organic growth by segment in F4Q26: Intelligent Devices +5% (GS +2%), Software & Control +15% (GS +16%), Lifecycle Services +2% (GS -1.5%).
FY27 adjusted EPS guidance of $14.50 to $15.50 (company guidance, introduced 5 Nov 2026) compares with GS FY27E EPS of $14.90. GS FY26E EPS is $13.30.
GS estimates: FY26E revenue $9,028.6mn, FY27E $9,515.7mn, FY28E $9,987.7mn. FY27E EBITDA is $2,549.1mn.
